boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along Oberlin’s College and Main Street downtown corridors, each with a documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Gibson's Bakery
cards.subtitle: West College Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk the West College Street block for Gibson’s listed bakery, grocery, candy, and snack counter; use the address to orient your downtown errand loop.
cards.short_summary: A bakery-and-provisions stop on West College Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin College lists Gibson's at 23 W. College St. as a bakery offering groceries, candy, and snacks.
cards.source_title: Restaurants in Oberlin | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Listed at 23 W. College St.; confirm current service details directly before visiting.

cards.title: Aladdin's Eatery
cards.subtitle: West College Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the short West College Street stretch for a casual stop with coffee, juices, baked goods, and pita-based menu items listed by the college.
cards.short_summary: A casual café-and-pita option near the College Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin College lists Aladdin's Eatery at 5 W. College St. with coffee, juices, baked goods, and pita sandwiches.
cards.source_title: Restaurants in Oberlin | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Listed at 5 W. College St.; food and drinks require purchase.

cards.title: The Slow Train Cafe
cards.subtitle: East College Street corridor
cards.notes: Head along East College Street to the Slow Train for the college-listed coffee-house and music-café format; check its own channels for any program details.
cards.short_summary: A coffee house and music café on East College Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin College lists The Slow Train Cafe at 55 E. College St., Suite 3, as an organic coffee house and music cafe.
cards.source_title: Restaurants in Oberlin | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Listed at 55 E. College St., Suite 3; purchases may be required.

cards.title: Blue Rooster Bakehouse
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Make the South Main Street block a bakehouse stop for the scratch-made goods identified by Oberlin College; plan a purchase if you want to try them.
cards.short_summary: A scratch-made bakehouse on South Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin College lists Blue Rooster Bakehouse at 38 S. Main St. and describes its goods as scratch-made.
cards.source_title: Restaurants in Oberlin | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Listed at 38 S. Main St.; baked goods require purchase.

cards.title: The Local Coffee and Tea
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the South Main Street corridor for a coffee, tea, or baked-goods stop at this named café; pair it with other nearby downtown errands.
cards.short_summary: A coffee, tea, and baked-goods destination on South Main.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin College lists The Local Coffee and Tea at 23 S. Main St. with coffee, tea, and baked goods.
cards.source_title: Restaurants in Oberlin | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Listed at 23 S. Main St.; food and drinks require purchase.

cards.title: Taco Flavored Kisses
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Take the South Main Street block for a modern Mexican carryout option; the college specifically identifies this location as a fast-casual destination.
cards.short_summary: A fast-casual Mexican carryout stop on South Main.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin College lists Taco Flavored Kisses at 18 S. Main St. as fast casual, modern Mexican carryout.
cards.source_title: Restaurants in Oberlin | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Listed at 18 S. Main St.; carryout food requires purchase.

cards.title: ThiNi Thai
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Use this South Main Street address when you want a casual Thai meal in the downtown corridor; verify current carryout or dine-in details before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A casual Thai-food destination on South Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin College lists ThiNi Thai at 19 S. Main St. as casual Thai dining.
cards.source_title: Restaurants in Oberlin | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Listed at 19 S. Main St.; food requires purchase.

cards.title: Main Street Grille
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Choose this part of South Main Street for a breakfast, brunch, or lunch option; the college listing identifies omelets, pancakes, sandwiches, and salads.
cards.short_summary: A daytime-meal stop on the South Main corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin College lists Main Street Grille at 51 S. Main St. for breakfast, brunch, lunch, omelets, pancakes, sandwiches, and salads.
cards.source_title: Restaurants in Oberlin | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Listed at 51 S. Main St.; food requires purchase.

cards.title: Mandarin Chinese Restaurant
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Add this South Main Street address to a downtown food run for the casual Chinese and takeout option documented in the college’s visitor information.
cards.short_summary: A casual Chinese takeout option on South Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin College lists Mandarin Chinese Restaurant at 82 S. Main St. as Chinese, takeout, and casual.
cards.source_title: Restaurants in Oberlin | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Listed at 82 S. Main St.; food requires purchase.

cards.title: Bistro Bella Luna
cards.subtitle: East College Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the East College Street corridor for a sit-down bistro option with a French-Italian influence, as described in Oberlin College’s current visitor listing.
cards.short_summary: A French-Italian-influenced bistro on East College Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Oberlin College lists Bistro Bella Luna at 55 E. College St., Suite 4, as an American bistro with a French-Italian influence.
cards.source_title: Restaurants in Oberlin | Oberlin College and Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Listed at 55 E. College St., Suite 4; meals require purchase.
